description: NaPHO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three H and three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.69-2.77 Å. There is one shorter (2.19 Å) and two longer (2.26 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one H and five O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.62 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.71 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.65 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.50 Å) and two longer (1.63 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na atoms. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na atoms. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two P atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one P atom.
